public_body: Brookline 9Th School Ad Hoc Subcommittee Of The Advisory Committee
overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the November 9, 2017 joint executive session discussions fit Purposes 3 and 6. Procedural allegations raised only in the further-review request were not reviewed, and no remedy was ordered.

allegations.summary: Complainants alleged the three bodies convened in a November 9, 2017 joint executive session without a proper statutory purpose.
allegations.key_passage: Because the discussions that took place during the November 9, 2017 joint executive session tracked these permissible topics, we find that the bodies did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: The request for further review alleged the bodies failed to follow proper procedure before convening in executive session; this was not in the original complaints.
The request for further review alleged the bodies failed to make meeting minutes available within the required time frame; this was not in the original complaints.
The request for further review alleged the bodies failed to appropriately review the Open Meeting Law complaints; this was not in the original complaints.
Not raised by any complaint, the AG noted the bodies did not respond to the complaints within the 14-business-day period required by law and reminded them of their obligations.
allegations.key_passage: Although not raised in a complaint, we note that the bodies did not respond to the complaints within the time frame required by law.
